cases.question: To whom can Meridian employees raise concerns about harassment or discrimination?
cases.reference_answer: Concerns can be raised with a line manager, with HR, or anonymously through the Ethics Hotline at ethics@meridian.example.

cases.question: How many days of holiday can I carry over to the next year?
cases.reference_answer: You can carry forward up to 10 unused days, but they must be used by 31 March of the following year or they will expire.

cases.question: What is the per diem for meals and incidentals in tier-1 cities?
cases.reference_answer: The per diem is USD 60 per day in tier-1 cities.

cases.question: Can I accept a gift worth USD 60 from a supplier?
cases.reference_answer: No, any gift above USD 50 must be declined or reported to Compliance within 5 working days.

cases.question: How long does my manager have to approve my leave request?
cases.reference_answer: The line manager must approve leave requests within 3 working days.

cases.question: How many days in advance must flights and hotels be booked through the corporate travel desk?
cases.reference_answer: They must be booked at least 7 days before departure.

cases.question: If my company laptop gets lost or stolen, how quickly do I need to let the IT team know?
cases.reference_answer: You must report a lost or stolen device to IT Security within 24 hours.

cases.question: How many days of paid sick leave do we get each year?
cases.reference_answer: Employees receive 12 days of paid sick leave per year.
key_facts: 12 days of paid sick leave per year

cases.question: By when must expense claims be submitted after returning from a trip?
cases.reference_answer: Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of returning from the trip.
key_facts: within 30 days of returning from the trip

cases.question: How many days per year can staff work from another country?
cases.reference_answer: Working from another country is limited to 20 days per year and requires written approval from HR.

cases.question: How many days of paid bereavement leave are granted on the death of a spouse?
cases.reference_answer: Up to 5 days of paid bereavement leave are granted on the death of a spouse.
key_facts: Up to 5 days of paid bereavement leave are granted on the death of a spouse, child, parent or sibling.

cases.question: Is travel time on weekends credited as leave or time off in lieu?
cases.reference_answer: No, travel time on weekends is not credited as leave or time off in lieu unless the line manager approves compensatory time in writing.
key_facts: travel time on weekends is not credited as leave or time off in lieu
unless the line manager approves compensatory time in writing

cases.question: If an employee loses a company laptop while on a business trip, what must they do regarding the device and what is the maximum hotel nightly rate they can claim in London?
cases.reference_answer: They must report the lost or stolen laptop to IT Security, and the hotel nightly rate in London is capped at USD 180.
key_facts: Lost or stolen devices must be reported to IT Security
Hotel stays are capped at USD 180 per night in tier-1 cities

cases.question: Can an employee who needs a medical certificate for sick leave also accept a gift worth more than USD 50 from a supplier?
cases.reference_answer: No. The employee must provide a medical certificate for the sick leave and is prohibited from accepting gifts worth more than USD 50 from suppliers.

cases.question: An employee plans a 5-hour flight and wants to work remotely from another country for 10 days; what are the travel booking requirements and the remote‑work approval limits?
cases.reference_answer: The flight must be booked in economy class because it is under 6 hours, and working from another country requires written HR approval and is limited to 20 days per year.
key_facts: Economy class is mandatory for flights under 6 hours
Working from another country requires written approval from HR

cases.question: If an employee reports harassment and also requests leave during the quarter‑end closing week, how long will it take for the report to be acknowledged and who must approve the leave?
cases.reference_answer: The report will be acknowledged within 2 working days, and the leave can only be approved by the Head of Department.
key_facts: Reports are acknowledged within 2 working days
is granted only with Head of Department approval

cases.question: What is the policy on travel?
cases.reference_answer: Either ask which is meant, or give both: All flights and hotels must be booked through the corporate travel desk at least 7 days before departure. / Travel time on weekends is not credited as leave or time off in lieu, unless the line manager approves compensatory time in writing.
key_facts: All flights and hotels must be booked through the corporate travel desk at least 7 days before departure.
Travel time on weekends is not credited as leave or time off in lieu, unless the line manager approves compensatory time in writing.

cases.question: What is the maximum allowed number of days?
cases.reference_answer: Either ask which is meant, or give both: 30 calendar days / 20 days per year
